spanish: Si en el boquete es hallado el ladrón, y es herido y muere, no hay a él sangres.

findings.issue: H4290 is the feminine singular noun for a breaking-in (burglary), the circumstance in which the thief is found. «boquete» replaces that with a physical hole.

notes: Passives, 3ms thief, plural דָּמִים, and unspecified לוֹ stay open.
